name: Mathematical Physics
description: Vector spaces and matrices;  complex analysis - analyticity, series representations, contour integration,  conformal transformations, branch cuts;  Fourier transforms and their applications;  series solution to ordinary differential equations - hypergeometric functions and their properties; Sturm-Liouville problem - examples and applications;  partial differential equations - Laplace, wave and heat conduction equations;  Green's function technique and its applications.
